verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a payments/POS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no data-export or account-portability feature. The nearest items are a marketing mention of "powerful reporting" and API/MCP access to review transactions; these are adjacent features and developer building blocks, not a documented export-all-data-in-open-formats capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
